==Notes==
*For the first 30 seconds, it's impossible to use [[Totem of Man]] as it is recharging.
*When you activate this skill, all [[Upkeep]] Enchantments you maintain will be removed.
*When the blessing ends, you get your original skill bar back and Volfen Blessing starts recharging.
*Good synergy with [[Quickening Zephyr]], especially at higher Norn ranks, because [[Volfen Bloodlust]] can be maintained indefinitely.
*Since this blessing and all associated skills do not require a weapon to be used, they can be used while carrying [[bundle]]s.
*Synergizes well with [[Binding Ritual]]s; the spirits will keep attacking even when your normal skills are disabled, and the spirits' attacks are affected by Volfen Bloodlust. 
{{anomaly|Although it is classified as a Form, the caster does not change appearance.}}
